newsitem.title: POLAND: KPW clears BIG new share issue.
newsitem.headline: KPW clears BIG new share issue.

text.p: The Polish Securities Commission (KPW) cleared for public trade the new issue of 60 million to 75 million shares by Bank Inicjatyw Gospodarczych SA (BIG) to finance a planned merger with Bank Gdanski.

The KPW said in a statement on Thursday that it also approved that BIG and the Bank of New York conclude an agreement whereby up to 55 million shares could be reserved for Global Depositary Receipts (GDRs).
BIG has said it hopes to complete the merger by the end of September. Tranches No Of Shares Subscription

*The record date is July 14. If all shares are not subscribed, shares will be allotted to investors taking part in book-building, bidding at or above the issue price and who subscribe for no fewer shares than at book-building. Lead Manager: Dom Maklerski BIG-BG Sp zoo
Main Shareholders: Insurer PZU SA - 9.5 pct of shareholder votes Life insurer PZU Zycie SA - 9.8 pct of shareholder votes
